hooks.command: cd D:/workspace/git/Interactive-Guide && f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q '^$' && echo '{"systemMessage": "Typecheck: PASS"}' || echo '{"systemMessage": "Typecheck: FAILED — fix type errors"}'; fi

cd D:/workspace/git/Interactive-Guide && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -q '^$' && echo '{"systemMessage": "Typecheck: PASS"}' || echo '{"systemMessage": "Typecheck: FAILED — fix type errors before committing"}'

cd D:/workspace/git/Interactive-Guide && npx eslint src/ tests/ --max-warnings 0 > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage": "Lint: PASS"}' || echo '{"systemMessage": "Lint: FAILED — fix lint errors before committing"}'
